metadata.title: Conformal dimension of Bedford-McMullen carpets
metadata.abstract: We show that the Hausdorff dimension of a Bedford-McMullen carpet with non-uniform fibres can be lowered with a quasisymmetry, provided that the defining iterated function system does not have a full column. We prove this by constructing explicit dimension lowering metrics which are quasisymmetrically equivalent to the Euclidean metric.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对非均匀纤维的Bedford–McMullen carpet，若定义IFS不含full column，则构造与Euclidean度量拟对称等价的新度量，使Hausdorff维数下降。
techniques: 非均匀纤维自仿射分形
analysis.breakthrough: 表明所述地毯的Euclidean Hausdorff维数不为其拟对称类的最小维数。
analysis.limitations: 要求非均匀纤维且无full column；摘要给严格降维，不自动给conformal dimension的精确值或所有地毯分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
